plugins.name: demoday
plugins.description: Creates demo videos for your projects. Claude is given tools to drive the browser/cli, make recordings, and uses FAL.ai, ElevenLabs, and remotion to build a demo video with scene transitions. Supports both 16:9 promo/tutorial demos, and Short cut 9:16 listicle/cohost videos. Open source and MIT licensed.
